insight.headline: Merchant notes on store credit transactions
insight.what_changed: As of GraphQL Admin API version 2027-01, you can attach a merchant-only note when crediting or debiting a store credit account and read those notes on store credit transactions. Notes are optional, so existing integrations continue to work without changes or required updates.
